newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela food consumption off 25 pct in 96 - report.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela food consumption off 25 pct in 96 - report.

text.p: Venezuelan food consumption fell 24.8 percent in 1996 compared with the year before according to a survey by local pollster Datanalisis, leading daily El Nacional reported.

Hard bit by a stiff package of economic reforms launched in April last year, Venezuelans bought 34 percent less meat, 28 percent less fish and 12 percent fewer eggs, the poll showed. But consumption of staples such as pasta, rice and flour rose between four and six percent, the paper reported.

Real wages were devastated by triple digit inflation last year, but are expected to rise in the second half of 1997 on pending salary increases, the poll said, leading to a rebound in food consumption.
